tagging_basis: AQA 7037 specification codes; AS units mapped to the matching A-level leaf

units.summary: Explain how unequal access to markets affects a country's economic well-being.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 explanation of familiar trade content; no data or case study needed.

units.summary: Analyse a scatter graph linking globalisation attitudes, GDP change, total GDP and foreign-born share.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of a multi-variable graph with bubble size and shading; no own knowledge needed.

units.summary: Using two Antarctic tourism sources, judge the extent to which tourism threatens Antarctica.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1/AO2 evaluation applying knowledge to novel figures (chart plus photograph); short extent judgement.

units.summary: Evaluate whether the UN or transnational corporations have been more successful in promoting growth and stability.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark AO1/AO2 essay requiring comparative evaluation of two agents and sustained argument across the theme.

units.summary: Outline ways geospatial data can be used to present characteristics of a place.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a skills-based technique; familiar content, no data.

units.summary: Analyse the relationship between perceived safety and recorded violent crime in Cardiff from two figures.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of qualitative survey and mapped crime data, linking two sources.

units.summary: Using a web extract and own knowledge, evaluate attempts to shape the meaning of a place.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1/AO2 evaluation applying knowledge to a novel qualitative source on place representation.

units.summary: Assess whether globalisation has transformed and improved places, using the student's distant place study.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay needing a distant place study plus synoptic link to globalisation in Section A.

units.summary: Outline how one urban pollution reduction policy has been put into practice.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of one familiar strategy; credit for named urban example.

units.summary: Analyse life expectancy and deprivation along a Sheffield bus route.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of spatial pattern and relationship between two variables; explanation not credited.

units.summary: Using an OS map extract of Plymouth, assess the importance of physical factors in urban form.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess item applying knowledge to unfamiliar OS map with physical versus human weighing.

units.summary: Assess the role of technological processes in the growth in the number of megacities.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess item (AO1 4 AO2 5) requiring evaluation of one factor against others.

units.summary: Evaluate whether urban drainage offers more opportunities than challenges for sustainable cities.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay linking drainage to sustainable urban development; sustained evaluative judgement.

units.summary: Outline how the physical environment relates to health in a studied local area.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline needing one local example; familiar content.

units.summary: Analyse air pollution deaths by income group and the global pattern of PM2.5.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of a graph and a choropleth map, connecting both.

units.summary: Using three sources, discuss the political implications of international migration.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark AO1/AO2 discuss item applying knowledge to three novel figures including data and placards.

units.summary: Assess the relative importance of two zonal soils in determining human activity such as agriculture.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess item requiring knowledge of two soils and a comparative judgement.

units.summary: Assess whether non-communicable diseases are harder to manage than biologically transmitted diseases, with named places.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay comparing management of two disease types using place evidence.

units.summary: Outline how an Environmental Impact Assessment can encourage sustainable resource development.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a single named specification concept.

units.summary: Analyse the relationship between mineral mining sites and rock types on a Lake District map.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of a geological map with located mining symbols; no recall required.

units.summary: Assess the relative importance of climate and geology in water supply.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess item (AO1 4 AO2 5) requiring comparison of two physical controls on volume and quality.

units.summary: Assess whether ore extraction always has greater environmental impact than water supply schemes, using named schemes.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay needing two case examples and a comparative evaluation across resource types.
